events.content:
Built the Next.js book tracker. The home page shows books you’re reading and books you’ve finished. You can add a book, save and update notes, mark it finished, and copy its individual page link.

Books are saved in [data/books.json](/workspace/data/books.json), so they survive a restart when the app runs on a writable, persistent filesystem. Run it with `npm install` and `npm run dev`, then open `http://localhost:3000`. Setup details are in the [README](/workspace/README.md).

The production build, type check, JSON persistence check, and live add → notes → finish flow all passed.

item.text:
Built the Next.js book tracker. The home page shows books you’re reading and books you’ve finished. You can add a book, save and update notes, mark it finished, and copy its individual page link.

Books are saved in [data/books.json](/workspace/data/books.json), so they survive a restart when the app runs on a writable, persistent filesystem. Run it with `npm install` and `npm run dev`, then open `http://localhost:3000`. Setup details are in the [README](/workspace/README.md).

The production build, type check, JSON persistence check, and live add → notes → finish flow all passed.
